about.title: The island, in full colour
about.dek: A premium magazine, directory and concierge for life in the Republic of Cyprus — in seven languages.

p: Cyprus Lifestyle is the definitive guide to visiting, living and investing in the Republic of Cyprus. We cover the whole of the island's south — from the tavernas of the Troodos foothills to the marinas of Limassol and the sands of the east — with the eye of a resident and the standards of an international title.

We are three things at once: a magazine of considered writing on property, culture and the good life; a directory of real, verified businesses; and a concierge that answers, in your language, the practical questions of arriving and settling in.

Every article, listing and answer is available in English, Greek, Romanian, Arabic, German, Polish and Russian — fully translated, never machine-guessed at the moment of reading. Cyprus is a genuinely international island, and we address its readers in the language they think in.

sections.h: Part of ADD Individual Solutions Ltd
p: Cyprus Lifestyle is the media title of the Media department of ADD Individual Solutions Ltd, based in Nicosia, Cyprus. Our editorial judgements are made independently of commercial relationships; our Editorial Standards explain how we keep that line clear.
We welcome tips, corrections, partnership enquiries and readers simply saying hello. You will find every relevant address on our Contact page, and our concierge is always a message away.

advertise.title: Advertise with Cyprus Lifestyle
advertise.dek: Reach the quarter of Cyprus that was born elsewhere — investors, relocators and high-spending visitors — in seven languages, from €49 a month.
body: One in four people in Cyprus today was born somewhere else. They are relocating, buying homes, opening companies and spending well — and they choose where to eat, stay and buy in English, Greek, Russian, Arabic, Romanian, Polish and German. Cyprus Lifestyle is the one title that reaches them in all seven, in a single, considered place.

Put your business on the map our readers search, let our editors write a feature about it, sponsor the section your customers live in, or take the Saturday newsletter. Every placement runs across all seven editions — translation included, because that is simply how we publish.

We are opening partnerships to the first 100 businesses at founding rates: a fraction of our published price, locked for as long as you stay. A verified listing is €149 for the year; the full Featured presence is €49 a month. Choose a placement below, or tell us about your brand and we will send the one-page media kit. Prices exclude VAT.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection
privacy.dek: How Cyprus Lifestyle collects, uses and protects your personal data, in line with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Cypriot law.

p: Cyprus Lifestyle is the media title of ADD Individual Solutions Ltd (Media department), a company based in Nicosia, in the Republic of Cyprus, which is the data controller for the personal data described here. For any data-protection matter you can reach us at privacy@cypruslifestyle.eu.

We collect only what we need. When you contact us, subscribe to the Saturday Letter, or ask our concierge to arrange something, we collect the details you provide — typically your name, your email address, and any phone number or message you choose to share. If you become a member, we hold the account and billing information needed to provide the service. When you browse, we collect limited, privacy-friendly analytics about how the site is used.

sections.h: Why we use it, and our legal bases
p: We use your data to reply to you, to send the Saturday Letter you asked for, to route and fulfil concierge requests, to provide membership, and to keep the site secure and improve it. Our legal bases are your consent (for the newsletter and for concierge requests you submit), the performance of a contract (for membership), and our legitimate interests (for security, fraud prevention and understanding how the site is used). You can withdraw consent at any time.

We keep cookies to a minimum. We use privacy-friendly, cookieless analytics that do not track you across other websites. A small preference cookie remembers the language you choose, so the site opens in it next time. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

sections.h: The services that process data for us
p: We rely on a small number of reputable processors, each bound by a data-processing agreement: Supabase (database and authentication), Vercel (hosting and cookieless analytics), Resend (transactional email), Stripe (payments), and OpenAI and Anthropic (which power the multilingual concierge). They process data only on our instructions and only as far as needed to provide their service.

Some of these providers may process data outside the European Economic Area. Where they do, the transfer is protected by appropriate safeguards — such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses — so that your data continues to enjoy GDPR-level protection.

sections.h: How long we keep your data
p: We keep personal data only for as long as necessary for the purpose it was collected: concierge and contact enquiries for as long as needed to handle them and a reasonable period afterwards; newsletter data until you unsubscribe; and membership data for the life of the account and any period required by law. We then delete or anonymise it.

Under the GDPR you have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, to have it corrected or erased, to restrict or object to its processing, to receive it in a portable format, and to withdraw any consent you have given. Exercising these rights is free and will not disadvantage you.

Write to privacy@cypruslifestyle.eu and tell us what you would like. We will respond within one month, as the GDPR requires. To protect you, we may need to confirm your identity before acting on a request.

If you are not satisfied with how we have handled your data, you have the right to complain to the Cypriot supervisory authority: the Office of the Commissioner for Personal Data Protection, 15 Kypranoros Street, 1061 Nicosia, Cyprus — telephone +357 22 818 456, email commissioner@dataprotection.gov.cy.
We may update this policy as our services or the law evolve. When we make a material change we will update the date above and, where appropriate, tell you directly.

standards.title: Editorial Standards
standards.dek: How we choose what to publish, and how we keep it honest.

p: Every business we list is a real, operating enterprise that we have checked against its own website and public records. We do not invent places, prices, ratings or contact details, and we correct anything we get wrong. Where we quote a price or a practical figure we give the honest caveats — for services, we advise obtaining two or three quotes.

Our editorial writing — articles, reviews and recommendations — is independent and is not for sale. Advertising, sponsored features and promoted listings are a normal part of how a media business operates; wherever content is paid for, we label it clearly, so you always know what is editorial and what is commercial.

Every business we list is real and verified against its own website and public records. A standard listing is earned on merit and is free to request, correct or remove. Businesses may also choose to feature or promote their listing — a clearly marked, paid option that never changes whether a business is genuine or how we verify it.
If you believe something we have published is inaccurate, please tell us. We review every request promptly and, where a correction is warranted, we make it openly.
Our editorial scope is the Republic of Cyprus. We do not cover or list businesses in the occupied north. This is a factual decision about the territory we know and serve.

whenToVisit.title: When to visit Cyprus
whenToVisit.intro: Warm, dry and swimmable for half the year. Here's the island month by month — day temperature, sea temperature, and whether it's beach weather.
whenToVisit.best: The sea is warmest in August and September, but May, June, October and early November are gloriously swimmable with lighter crowds. Winter is mild and green — made for exploring more than for the beach; evenings from October cool quickly, so pack a light jacket.
